notes.title: Happy 6 Months! 🔎(Ver. 1.02.3)
notes.content:
Hello!

I know it's been a while since the last major update, so today I have a new version with some interesting additions.

[list]
[*] 18 new available themes have been introduced to the existing gallery (for a total of 35).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936626/517011309c8fbd8aa6e88b336cf815d4c9492898.png[/img]

[*] The Global Statistics window has been added, which now includes a list of all the data collected from the game about your game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936626/de72501043d08841a5587ce54bb5d1d1bbd6e081.png[/img]

[*] A tab with a calendar of all the daily challenges has been introduced in the statistics window, showing the challenges already obtained, as well as the score and stars obtained in each one, so that it is easier to know which ones are still needed if you want to complete the whole year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936626/37becbd06642c42109c9ed88785cc27301c24a01.png[/img]
[/list]

I hope this update is very convenient for everyone, there were already several people requesting something like this and I hope you like it.

There will be more news with new updates soon, but that's all for now. Have a great time!

[i]-Baimason.[/i]

notes.title: Bye bye ugly achievements!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the achievement of "Completing the daily challenge for 180 days" to "Getting 3 stars on all levels in the main game"
[*] Changed the achievement of "Completing the daily challenge for 365 days" to a hidden achievement ;)
[*] Fixed a couple of bugs related to coloring levels in the main menu
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936626/6f8c8de3bb1e0d2ec187c94b6f5c70589ad45091.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.02.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Slightly modified the hitbox of objects to avoid misclicks
[*]Added a small animation to indicate the hovered object more clearly
[*]Added a new bat 🦇
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.02.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that reset selected settings when entering a level
[*]Fixed bug that when selecting the wrong object its name would only appear in Spanish
[*]Fixed bug that restarting the level once completed would not save your previous progress
[*]Added an extra nut because I like the way it looks
[*]Minor adjustments and alignment of certain objects corrected
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Wrong object name indicator added
[*]Added the option to activate an additional marker for the cursor in the options
[*]Added the option to switch to window mode
[*]The option to change the screen size manually is added
  (not tested in every aspect ratio)
[*]Added the option to hide the timer on the find objects screen
[*]The little dog that no one liked is removed :(
[*]Minor performance fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936626/e55b5b7ed1c25878eabfa0db9dd3b211d207ff81.png[/img]
